name: requality-vscode
description: Unofficial port of the Requality Eclipse plug-in (ISP RAS) for requirements management. It runs the original Requality core and plug-in code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Requality starts a Java server that reads and writes the catalogs in the workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Requality catalogs must be on the local file system.

commands.title: Test processor for updating old markup

viewsWelcome.contents:
No Requality projects in this workspace.
[New Requality Project](command:requality.newProject)
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)

The Requality server is not running.
[Restart Requality Server](command:requality.restartServer)
[Show Server Log](command:requality.showLog)

keybindings.when: focusedView == requality.explorer || requality.focusedView == requality.explorerView || focusedView == requality.links || requality.focusedView == requality.links
focusedView == requality.explorer || requality.focusedView == requality.explorerView || focusedView == requality.links || requality.focusedView == requality.links

colors.description: Requality Links Explorer: nodes referencing the selection (LinksDecorator).
Requality Links Explorer: nodes referenced by the selection (LinksDecorator).
Nodes not connected to the repository (RepoDecorator).

requality.java.home.markdownDescription: JDK/JRE (17 or newer) used to run the Requality server. Empty: `JAVA_HOME`, then `java` on `PATH`.

requality.server.maxHeap.description: Maximum Java heap of the Requality server (-Xmx).

enumDescriptions: The view of the Eclipse plug-in (RequalityCNF): its tree with the images and colors of the explorer, its popup menu, drag and drop with Shift, Ctrl and Alt, and its key bindings.
A VS Code tree with the items of the explorer and the commands of its popup menu (VS Code reports no modifier keys of a drop: the kind of drop is picked).
requality.explorer.view.description: How the Requality Explorer is shown. Changing it restarts the Requality server.

requality.explorer.linkWithEditor.description: Link the Requality Explorer selection with the active editor.

requality.window.title.description: Use the window title of Eclipse (workspace name, perspective, active editor, location and product, as Preferences > General > Workspace selects them) as the title of the VS Code window (the window.title setting of the workspace; a title you set there yourself is kept).

resourcesInRequalityProjects.description: Resource in Requality Project Filter (a catalog shows its nodes, not its files)

requality.explorer.contentExtensions.description: Requality Explorer content extensions (Filters and Customization > Content): id -> active.

requality.explorer.userFilters.description: Requality Explorer user filters (Filters and Customization > User filters): resources whose names match an enabled pattern are hidden.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run compile
scripts.test: npm run build:server && npm run test:server && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
